label: prf:confinement-universality
title: Proof of confinement universality
html: The confinement word \mathcal{B}_3 \cdot C(f_1, f_2; \sigma_0) \cdot C(f_1, f_3; \sigma_0) \cdot C(f_2, f_3; \sigma_1) is built from the braid \mathcal{B}_3 and the typed crossings C(f_i, f_j; \sigma). Each typed crossing is fixed by the flavour pair and the generator, and none of them contains a photon coefficient. Its normal form is therefore a function of q and f alone, and \mathfrak{N}(\varphi_0, \varphi_1, \varphi_{01}) = \mathfrak{N}_f for every value of the photon coefficients. The argument uses no property of the coefficient ring.
